channel.title: MAG 7 Daily
channel.description:
Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla as one daily desk: the products, models and chips they shipped, the research they published, the rulings and deals that change what they can do, and one story that runs across several of them. Developments and numbers, never picks. Not financial advice.
